descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S15 Local-development leftovers do not reach a shipped build

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere. (UAT OAT-02; UAT 4; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given The UAT build's source and its release artefacts

When Look for each known leftover: .env.mobile.local (VITE_MOBILE_LOCAL=true, http://127.0.0.1:3210/3211 or a LAN IP); the SITE_URL fallback 'http://localhost:5173' in convex/auth.ts; the trusted origins http://localhost, *.e2b.app and WebContainer; …

Then None of them makes a hosted or store build talk to an http:// host. SITE_URL on the deployment is the https web origin. The store builds were made with VITE_MOBILE_LOCAL=false and https URLs.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-02 step 1. A shipped build that sends any request to an http:// host = Fail. Any http:// entry in BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS other than localhost = Fail. Allowances that carry no traffic, localhost origins included, are judged per Q6.

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane code-review.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: code-review.

UAT item: OAT-02 Encryption Verification · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-02/S15

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress)

Detail:

Source leftovers: Android debug network config allows cleartext to localhost, 127.0.0.1, 172.20.10.6 (debug builds only); iOS NSAllowsLocalNetworking present; .env.mobile.local is git-ignored (not in the commit). The convex/auth.ts SITE_URL fallback and trusted origins are backend code, see OAT-02/S06 and OAT-02/S08's code review; the SITE_URL and BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS values on the deployment need Tim (CONFIG).

Still needs (needs): CONFIG (Tim): scheme of SITE_URL and each BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS entry; store build env (VITE_MOBILE_LOCAL=false, https URLs)

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: scripted-spec, outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
